about: Spike 4 raw results (2026-10-08). Chromium on macOS, 48 kHz, sync lab in nudgecal mode, pelados.gp with the generated beep backing track (src=beeps). Start-test rows read: 'first 5 click offsets (ms) | firstGap = first click minus first backing-track beep (ms), ok/SKIP, clicks/beeps | controller re-syncs after Play | ms until clicks stay within 3 ms'. A start is SKIP when the first beep after Play has no click within 50 ms.

asBuilt_1x_settle4ms_noSkipCheck.note: first run of the day, before the skip check existed

asBuilt_1.5x.note: SKIP here = the backing track's own first beep is missing (one more click than beeps); the synth plays the first beat

latencyOffsetForcedBelowZero_1x.note: first row = first start after a speed change (start lead learned at 1.5x)

startAtTarget_0.5x.note: first row = first start at this speed (no start lead learned yet)

startAtTarget_1.5x.note: SKIP = backing track's own first beep missing, as in asBuilt_1.5x

loopTests.note: 2-bar loop from beat 40, start at target + settle 12 ms. missing = beep without a click within 50 ms; extra = click without a beep; gaps = ms added at a wrap beyond one beat (only values > 15 ms listed).

A_combinedOwnsWrap.note: the backing track's first beat after each restart is missing (Chrome time-stretch start)

backingTrackFirstBeatLevel.note: RMS envelope peaks (dBFS) of the beep backing track after Play exactly on a beat, 4 starts per speed. At 1.5x the beep at the start position (t = 0) is missing in all 4.

spike5UnprobedSpeeds.what: MixSpikePlayer._measureLatency(rate): real ms between hearing a probe beep and <audio>.currentTime reaching it (median over the probe file), 3 runs per speed; background = the page's own background probe at load
spike5UnprobedSpeeds.guessRule: linear between the nearest probed speeds (medians incl. background: 0.5x 60, 0.75x 25.5, 1x 0.75, 1.25x -4.4, 1.5x -6.7); outside them the nearest probed value

spike5PlayBeat.what: sync lab 1x, silent (taps only), metronome on, tracks muted; play from 20 s, after 3 s api.playBeat(first beat of bar 13, track 1; 2 notes); count synth-tap clicks and media-tap beeps

spike5ClickLevel.what: sync lab src=mp3 (pelados.gp recording), 1x, silent, metronomeVolume 1, synth tracks muted; AnalyserNode fftSize 1024 (21 ms) every 10 ms for 10 s from 20 s; sum busses: default mix media 1/synth 1, spike page mix media 0.35/synth 2

spike6CountIn.what: sync lab nudgecal, beeps, 4-beat count-in emulated (synth starts 4 beats before the target, metronome only); media paused until play() issued a learned media-start latency before the boundary frame from the worklet stamps; downbeat = synth click nearest the media first beep (click - beep, + = click late); settle threshold 12 ms + settle nudge gain 300 at 1x

spike6StartPreRoll05x.what: spikeStartTest(8, beforeBeatMs, 0.5): both start beforeBeatMs of media time before a beat; settle 12 ms + gain 300 at 1x; startAtTarget true = synth at the target then catch-up, false = synth at media position + latency offset

spike6YouTubeStart.what: playground youtube-sync page, second muted hidden YT.Player (by8oyJztzwo, controls 0); per start: seekTo(T), wait, playVideo(), getCurrentTime() sampled ~continuously for 1.5 s, line fitted from 300 ms; fittedStartMs = where the line crosses T (ms after playVideo); then pauseVideo()
spike6YouTubeStart.batch2_columns: T | fittedStartMs | rate | maxDevMs | state events (3=buffering,1=playing,2=paused @ ms after playVideo)

spike7PlayBeat.what: api.playBeat (bar 13 beat 1, track 1, 2 notes, 333 ms) clicked 2.5 s after Play. Mixed: sync lab nudgecal, beeps, 1x, settle 12 ms / gain 300; MixSpikePlayer.oneTimeMidiMode = synthOnly (as built) / pauseBoth (option 1) / pauseBothResume (option 2); pauseOnly = baseline api.pause(). audible = beat's track unmuted; otherwise tracks muted, metronome on, and the clicks after Play (pressed 1.5 s later) or after the automatic resume are matched to the media beeps (ms, click - beep). Non-mixed: control demo.

spike8Limiter.what: Output limiter settings (spec section 3; review lap 2, finding F-13). Offline Web Audio render (OfflineAudioContext) in the playground page, Chromium 152, macOS, 48 kHz, no alphaTab code. Worst case for clipping: a 20 ms 1 kHz click burst peaking at -11.4 dBFS x synthVolume, its crest on a crest of a 100 Hz 'recording' sine peaking at -2.3 dBFS (both levels from spike 5), clicks at 1 s and 2 s. Per run: peak = output peak (dBFS), over0 = samples over 0 dBFS, recordingOnly = the recording's own peak between clicks (0.5-0.9 s). hotRecording-0.3 = recording peaks at -0.3 dBFS. Script: spike-8-limiter-console.js.

makeupGainDb.note: Web Audio's automatic make-up gain, knee 0, ratio 20: 0.6 x the gain reduction at 0 dBFS input

asSpecified.note: knee, attack and release are the node's defaults (not set by the spec)

transportToday.setup: ExternalMediaPlayer (an AlphaSynthBase) with syncpoints-testfile.gp and a fake handler (transport.spike.test.ts, readiness.spike.test.ts)

externalMediaVolumeEcho.setup: fake element queueing volumechange only on a change, wired like alphaTab's external-media sample (volume from handler.masterVolume, volumechange -> api.masterVolume), 300 ms (volume-echo.mjs)

mediaStallVsAgreementRule.setup: Python model (stall_sim.py): updatePosition every 50 ms frozen during the stall from t=10000 ms; clock = line fit over the last 2 s; stamps every ~50 ms; 3 ms agreement rule; 120 ms locked re-sync; synth at 1x. resyncs: [t ms, agreed drift ms]. triggerOnFitMs = when 'drift grows by more than half the stamp interval' first fires, after the freeze.

spike11SpeedChanges.about: Spike 11: speed changes during playback and starts at unlearned speeds (review lap 2, finding F-9), sync lab (mode nudgecal, generated beeps, pelados.gp 135-145 BPM), Chromium 152, 2026-10-09. settleResyncThreshold 12 (15 off 1x), settleNudgeGainMillis 300, media latency at unprobed speeds by straight-line guess.

sweeps.what: a held tempo sweep: 12 steps of 0.0072x (about 1 BPM) every 250 ms, after 3 s of settled playback; clicks vs beeps from 0 to 2 s after the last step. rule always = re-sync on every speed change (as built); ifDrift = settle only. worker asBuilt = AlphaSynth.updatePlaybackSpeed rescales + seeks in follow mode; keepPosition = spike patch, follow mode keeps its media-time position. p95 equals max with about 10 clicks, so only max is kept.

unlearnedStarts.what: compensated start (startAtTarget false) with the start lead learned per speed (spike patch compensatedLeadPerSpeed); first start at a speed with no learned lead, 30 ms before a beat; the speed probed first so only the lead differs. zero = as built; line = straight line between the learned speeds. firstGap = first click minus the first beep (ms).
